why: A startup wedge on a four-Spark switchless ring: rank 2's engine "stalls mid-load (no error)" in D-state with NFS rx at 0, rank 3 exits with ConnectFailed, and after a manual restart of rank 3 completes the TCP fan "zero RDMA bytes ever flow" and rank 0 never binds the API port. This needs full cold restarts and fabric/RDMA counters, not requests to the running API.
repro: Run a cold full restart of all four nodes with a plain ./start-switchless.sh on current main (it includes 0035, which opens rank 0's follower ports before its weights load). Do not docker start any rank by hand. Do it once with RANK_LOCAL=0, so rank 2 (the worker across the ring) loads over NFS through the neighbour hop, and once with RANK_LOCAL=1, which takes NFS out of the load. Keep send_redirects=0 on the head. Watch whether rank 2's engine goes past the PyTorch banner or sits in D-state with NFS rx at 0, whether any follower exits with ConnectFailed (keep TF_DS_CONNECT_S at its default of 300 s), whether port_xmit_data moves on each HCA once the TCP rendezvous is ESTABLISHED, and whether rank 0 binds the API port. Collect every rank's log. The issue was reported at 220547b, before 0035 and the MASTER_ADDR Tailscale guard in scripts/config.sh.
